name: The Waldorf Astoria New York
positioning: Fully restored Waldorf Astoria New York at 301 Park Avenue in Midtown Manhattan, with rooms designed by Pierre-Yves Rochon, Lex Yard by Chef Michael Anthony, Yoshoku and a 22,000-square-foot Guerlain Wellness Spa
best_for: History lovers who want to see Cole Porter's piano, the Waldorf Astoria Clock and the Silver Corridor
Food lovers who want a seasonal menu from Chef Michael Anthony and a Japanese tasting menu under one roof
Travelers who want a Midtown base near Rockefeller Center, Fifth Avenue and Grand Central Terminal

facts.text: The hotel is at 301 Park Avenue in Midtown Manhattan.
The hotel is less than two miles from Rockefeller Center, Fifth Avenue and Grand Central Terminal.
The hotel has been revitalized, fully restored and enriched with the latest technology.
Skidmore, Owings & Merrill led the transformation of the hotel.
Lex Yard is helmed by Chef Michael Anthony, with a menu of seasonal food and local ingredients.
Yoshoku serves Western interpretations of traditional Japanese dishes.
Yoshoku serves a Japanese six-course tasting menu in the Park Avenue lobby.
Afternoon tea is served at Yoshoku.
The concierge arranges curated experiences including intimate chef-curated dinners and live music.
Rooms are laid out so luggage never has to touch a carpeted area, with a hallway leading to a walk-in wardrobe.

highlights.text: Peacock Alley holds a Steinway piano that once belonged to Cole Porter and the Waldorf Astoria Clock, crafted for the 1893 Chicago World's Fair.
The Silver Corridor is a mirrored hallway with ceiling murals depicting the 12 months of the year and the four seasons.
The Basildon Room was shipped from Basildon Park, an 18th-century English estate, where it was a dining hall.
The Guerlain Wellness Spa covers 22,000 square feet, with facials, body treatments and wellness programs.
Guest rooms and suites were designed by Pierre-Yves Rochon.

considerations.text: There are no kids' clubs or babysitting service.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning and Manhattan location.
